A '''Gungan dunk tank''' was an attraction present during the [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|celebrations]] held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Boss/Legends|leader]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] invited others to dunk him into the [[Water/Legends|water]] tank.

==Description==
A Gungan dunk tank was an attraction used in funfairs by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It consisted of large, clear tank filled with [[Water/Legends|water]], over which a person was suspended, sitting on a short horizontal bar hung by two straps. By correctly sorting two-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[tima]]s according to their [[Color/Legends|colors]] and features, the player would activate a mechanism, making the seat fall into the tank and "dunking" whoever was sitting on it.<ref name="ELAC" />

==History==
Shortly after the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="ELAC" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a series of [[Freedom of Naboo/Legends|celebrations]] was held at both [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] and [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]&mdash;[[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|cities]] of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and Gungan people respectively&mdash;and the Gungan [[Boss/Legends|head]] of government, [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], agreed to sit over the dunk tank. When successfully dunked, Nass would react by making faces. The attraction was installed in Otoh Gunga, inside a temporary [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubble]] known as the "Dunk Boss Nass Bubble," and Rugor Nass himself invited visitors to give it a try.<ref name="ELAC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dunking of Boss Nass was one of the activities featured in ''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]'', a children's game released in [[2000]] by [[Lucas Learning]].<ref name="ELAC" /> [[Wikipedia:Dunk tank|Dunk tanks]] exist in real-life, although the player has to strike a target to make the seat fall into the tank of water.
